summary: The same existing identity is selected through a separate rendered feature step and behavior/test step. Design basis: AD-4 in docs/shiploop/architecture.md, Decisions / Marker spacing and contrast. Planned browser helper (not present yet) and node:test checks are not yet run; browser command: `node scripts/check-chat-unread-browser.mjs --viewports 390x844,1440x1000 --badge-layout --composer-reachable --out "$(mktemp -d)/observation"`.

criteria.text: Keep the unread count marker inside each current .conversation-item and retain the .message-thread and .composer composition, following AD-4 in docs/shiploop/architecture.md, sections Existing chat identity and count marker and Marker spacing and contrast. Select --chat-paper: #f4f0e8 and --chat-accent-soft: #ece7f6 plus the existing --chat-gap: 0.75rem as anchors. Check a rendered browser at narrow phone and wide desktop; each badge remains legible beside its conversation without displacing the message pane. This visual check is planned, not yet run.

Every seeded conversation's unread count is represented by its badge. Selecting a conversation clears that conversation's unread count and preserves the local thread and composer behavior. Planned regression command, not yet run: node --test test/chat-state.test.mjs; require the local conversation and message state tests to pass.

steps.task: Record the saved identity choices, add visible unread-count badges to existing conversation rows (C1), and create the planned browser observation helper.
Clear the opened conversation's count and retain the local message behavior (C2).
